[[Lohiz Hoput]] can be found on guard duty along the corridor in the central portion of the [[Citadel of Dzagon]].

==Locations==
*[[Vabbi]]
**{{NPC location|Wilderness of Bahdza}}

==Dialogue==
:''"Are you new? Don't worry, there are lots of newbies here. With all this fighting, we've been going through recruits pretty quickly lately. I try to see the bright side...think of all the people I've met without going anywhere!" ''

==Quotes==
:''"Calm down. Yes, it's exciting here. No, you don't have to report every single, tiny bug you see crossing the plains. Trust me...some of those bugs are fine right where they are."'' 
:''"I've traveled a lot...[[Istan]], [[Kourna]], [[Vabbi]]. And I have to tell you...people are so friendly in [[Elona]]!"''

==Trivia==
*This character's name, along with [[Louise Haup]], [[Losai Hapatu]] and [[Losi Hapatu]] is much-likely a tribute to Lois Haupt, the Alpha Tester of [[Guild Wars]] campaigns and [[Nightfall]] Guidebook.
